findings.title: Merge the present and early “small” sense of 小
findings.details: The article records the present sense as 小:small-current but marks the separately recorded oracle-bone “small” sense historical. The opening explanation and source evidence treat “small” as both an early attested use and the ordinary current meaning. The generated has_sense edges therefore split one continuing use into duplicate records.
findings.verification: Merge the early and current “small” records under one stable sense ID, mark it current, retain the early attestation and current-use citations, and ensure the generated has_sense edge reflects the merged record. Obtain fresh factual and readability approvals for the changed article.

findings.title: Keep the 小–少 relationship qualified as shared-graph evidence
findings.details: The relationship edge is labeled variant_of, while its text describes a shared early graph followed by differentiation and explicitly rejects a derivation direction. The evidence supports a qualified graphic relationship, but does not necessarily establish that 小 is a variant of 少; the predicate may overstate the relationship kind.
findings.verification: Review the cited analyses and choose a relationship predicate that represents the supported shared-graph/differentiation claim without asserting an unsupported variant direction. Keep competing claims distinct and obtain fresh factual review if the relationship changes.
